empirical_defects.description: UnboundLocalError: local variable 'Path' referenced before assignment during structured_feedback event consumption
empirical_defects.impact: Terminates the UI background consumer thread permanently. All subsequent mission events are left unconsumed in the queue, freezing visual progress display (e.g., stuck at [1/7]).
empirical_defects.reproduction: Simulated in scratch/reproduce_tui_crash.py by feeding a structured_feedback event into _consume_mission_events without prior workspace_ready event.

empirical_defects.description: ui/app.py does not propagate tool_name from pipeline_stage or tool execution events into ChatPanel.update_progress()
empirical_defects.impact: UI visual widget shows 'Tool: None' or 'unknown_tool' even while tools like write_files_batch and read_file are executing.
empirical_defects.reproduction: Confirmed via code inspection of ui/app.py:_consume_mission_events and mission event dispatching.
